name: Tam
aliases: the young man in the loft
status: dead (chapter 4, in the cage by the pound, of poison from his collar)

physicalDetails.detail: Very young, Dickon's age or thinner: long white neck, big red hands, hair cut close to the skull, fluff of fair hair along the lip, pale eyes; flour in the creases of his knuckles and down the front of his smock.
Collar of his smock: a sewn-in fold of waxed paper in the hem, corner chewed through; brownish smear on the cloth.

voiceMarkers.detail: Says only two things on page: 'I'm not to speak to you.' (twice) and 'You don't know what you're keeping them from.' Otherwise silent; high thin sound through his nose when frozen; sobs unheard.

beliefs.belief: He is protecting 'them' from the party ('You don't know what you're keeping them from.'); he is not to speak to the strangers.
beliefs.trueOrFalse: Cult-like conviction or conditioning; his gut is clean: he never ate the flour.

goalsAtChapterEnd.underlying: Keep the jar and the lookout post; die rather than talk.

emotionalStateAtChapterEnd.state: Dead; calm just before (face 'perfectly calm, calmer than it had been all evening').

decisionsThisChapter.detail: Hid in the granary loft with a lamp, lifting a clay jar (waxed cloth over the mouth) out of a hole under a floorboard; obeyed 'Put it down' by setting the jar down, then reached for the lamp and tried to throw it into the flour-dusted air (a dust explosion risk).
Refused every question; on the walk to the cage kept his chin on his collar; at the cage bit a poison from the sewn-in hem and died within minutes.

abilitiesDemonstrated.ability: Worked the hoist for Joss; took on at 'the back end of summer'; sat at Brask's harvest supper beside Brask's youngest.

bodyLanguagePatterns.detail: Puts the jar down with both hands, then lunges for the lamp; keeps his face turned away; knees dragging, bow-kneed and drunk-walking after the frost; chin down on his collar; sits on the cage bench with his hands between his knees; shivers; back arches, heels scrape, foam on the lip.

knowledge.detail: Knew about the jar, the floorboard, the watch, and the poison in his collar; was told 'when'. Whom he serves, who builds it, who the cart man is, are not revealed.

arc.currentPosition: Dead, a lookout who killed himself rather than talk.
